slides.title: Every workout has a job.
slides.body: A short one is meant to be fast and spicy. A long one is meant to be steady. The time is the point.

slides.title: Rx at any cost.
slides.body: Board weight, triple the time. You did a different workout, just with the right numbers.

slides.title: Scale to hit the time.
slides.body: Ask your coach for the target time. Pick the load and reps that land you inside it.

slides.title: Is round one unbroken?
slides.body: On a short workout, if round one already needs breaks, it's too heavy for today.

slides.title: Earn the Rx. Don't borrow it.
slides.body: Hit the target time scaled, then add load or reps next time. Progress you can actually see.
